OpenApi.//: Defaults to on in Development, off elsewhere. A public map of every endpoint is a reconnaissance aid.

Bootstrap.//: Used ONLY when the user table is empty. Never modifies an existing account. Remove after first run.

Jwt.//SigningKey: At least 32 chars. Startup fails without it. Use a secret store, never a committed file.

Cors.//: Empty disables CORS entirely. No permissive fallback.

DocumentServer.//: OnlyOffice Document Server. Leave Url empty to disable in-browser editing entirely.
DocumentServer.//CallbackBaseUrl: This API as the DOCUMENT SERVER sees it - usually an internal address, not the one browsers use.
DocumentServer.//TokenSecret: At least 32 chars. Required once Url is set; startup fails without it.

Development.//: Stand-in actor so Phase 1 can be exercised before an auth model exists. Read ONLY when the environment is Development (see HttpContextCurrentUser). Remove once auth lands.
